messages:
Nina: FYI: invoice-preview for tenant `edu-hub` shows ~+14% tokens vs final for 2026-04-01 12:00-12:20 UTC. noticed after automated sanity check.
Carlos: Was anything deployed around that time? rollout logs?
Yui: We flipped request-routing policy to prefer 'fast-path' proxy for short requests at 12:05. Could affect header propagation.
Nina: Preview rows include events before quota/dedupe; final tallies run after. Quick query: `SELECT hour, SUM(p.tokens)-SUM(t.tokens) as delta FROM previews p JOIN tallies t USING(hour, tenant) WHERE tenant='edu-hub' AND hour='2026-04-01 12:00' GROUP BY hour;`
Carlos: Ran sample: delta concentrated in 12:05-12:15, many requests have `x-req-id` missing or changed.
ReplayBot: Replay check: replayed 1k events through tally-ingest => 92% of missing-req-id events get collapsed (deduped) by tally.
Yui: Root cause likely proxy rewrite of req-id in fast-path. We didn't include x-req-id preservation in routing-policy.
InfraBot: deployment routing/fast-path toggled 2026-04-01T12:04:32Z by @Yui (canary->50%). No rollback.
Carlos: Fix options: patch proxy to preserve x-req-id, rollback routing change, or change preview to write post-quota. Prefer patch + canary.
Nina: Immediate mitigation: flag affected previews as 'stale' in console and pause auto-send for those hours.
Yui: I'll open PR to preserve headers and run canary. Also adding integration test to verify header passthrough.
Carlos: Reconciliation: run a short reconcile job that regenerates preview token sums from post-dedupe events for hours 12:00-12:30.
Nina: Add dashboard alert: preview_vs_tally delta > 5% for 10m -> page oncall.
InfraBot: Incident created INC-2026-402 assigned Yui/Carlos/Nina.
Yui: will update once canary passes.
